learning_objectives.description: Find and distinguish the net change and average rate of change. Interpret the average rate of change graphically as the slope the respective linear function

problems.name: Exercise A_a
problems.context_plain: A predator-prey model describes how the sizes of two populations -- predator P_1 and prey P_2 -- are related. Suppose two points describing a predator prey model are given by (P_1,P_2)=(100,1000) and (P_1,P_2)=(300,300).
problems.context_latex: A predator-prey model describes how the sizes of two populations -- predator $P_1$ and prey $P_2$ -- are related. Suppose two points describing a predator prey model are given by $(P_1,P_2)=(100,1000)$ and $(P_1,P_2)=(300,300)$.

plain_text.question: What is the net change of the prey population as the predator population changes from 100 to 300?
plain_text.answer: Delta P_2=300-1000=-700 when P_1 changes from 100 to 300

latex.question: What is the net change of the prey population as the predator population changes from $100$ to $300$?

plain_text.question: What is the average rate of change of the prey population with respect to the predator population?

latex.question: What is the average rate of change of the prey population with respect to the predator population?

plain_text.question: Assuming the predator-prey model is linear, what is the slope of the graph describing the relationship between the predator and prey populations?

latex.question: Assuming the predator-prey model is linear, what is the slope of the graph describing the relationship between the predator and prey populations?.

problems.name: Exercise A_b
problems.context_plain: The equation F = 9/5 C + 32 gives the relationship between temperature in degrees Fahrenheit (F) and temperature in degrees celsius (C).
problems.context_latex: The equation $F=\frac{9}{5}C+32$ gives the relationship between temperature in degrees Fahrenheit ($F$) and temperature in degrees celsius ($C$).

plain_text.question: What is the slope of the graph describing the relationship between F and C?

latex.question: What is the slope of the graph describing the relationship between $F$ and $C$?

plain_text.question: What is the (average) rate of change of the temperature in degrees Fahrenheit with respect to the temperature in degrees Celsius?

latex.question: What is the (average) rate of change of the temperature in degrees Fahrenheit with respect to the temperature in degrees Celsius?

plain_text.question: What is the net change in the temperature in degrees Fahrenheit when the temperature in degrees Celsius increases by 1?

latex.question: What is the net change in the temperature in degrees Fahrenheit when the temperature in degrees Celsius increases by $1$?

other_material.content_plain: Net change is the difference between two quantities; AROC and slope are mathematically the same; Both slope and AROC are computed by the quotient of net changes
